Collegium Musicum Iuvenale Ochsenfurt

Retrospective: Benefit Concert for the 200th Birthday of Johann Strauss

October 25, 2025 · Town Hall Marktbreit

On October 25, 2025, an international benefit concert for the 200th birthday of the Waltz King Johann Strauss, who was born on October 25, 1825, took place in the town hall of Marktbreit. The Veeh harp group "Querbeet" (led by Sigrid Schäfer), together with soloists from Collegium Musicum Iuvenale Ochsenfurt (led by Dr. Astrid Eitschberger) and guests from Italy (Chiara Passudetti, soprano, Silvano Ruffo, tenor, as well as Mirko Ballico on piano and Andrea Vinco on guitar), presented an entertaining program with works by Johann Strauss, his brother Josef, and their contemporaries from Italy and Spain. The evening was based on a cooperation with the Marktbreit-Fléac partnership committee and the Marktbreit secondary school. Secondary school students professionally explained background information in their presentations about excerpts from the operetta "A Night in Venice" and the famous waltz "The Blue Danube." A special highlight was the polka "Feuerfest!", in which Veeh harp musician Klaus Schäfer appeared as a blacksmith at the anvil and accentuated the rhythm with his hammer blows. During the break, guests were treated to lovingly prepared snacks made by the families of the students together with their class teacher Mrs. Baur. The warm atmosphere, the committed contributions of the young people, and the outstanding solo performances of the Italian musicians made the evening a special experience. The concert donations will benefit the students for their trip to France in 2026.
